title: Desktop White Screen Still
description: Investigate and fix Electron desktop blank renderer after sketchpad export fix.
summary: Fixed Electron main startup: register all IPC before createWindow (removed ready race), call createWindow from whenReady after handlers. Dev opens detached DevTools. Sketchpad: replace null/empty loading UIs with visible dark placeholders; harden loadAppConfigs and hydrateInitialState with catch/finally so init cannot hang on IndexedDB or merge errors; AppRouter shows loading text and initialize() logs failures.
